reading.passage: Online shopping has become part of everyday life. People order goods on the net and have them delivered home. It is convenient, and many sites even offer a discount.
reading.passageCn: 网购已成为日常生活的一部分。人们在网上订购商品并送货到家。这很方便,许多网站还提供折扣。

questions.q: Why do people enjoy online shopping?
opts: It is convenient and may offer discounts.
It needs a lot of cash.
It is only for big cities.

questions.q: How do the goods reach the buyers?
opts: They are delivered to people's homes.
Buyers must collect them at a store.

writing.promptCn: 写一篇简短的博客,给出两条安全上网的建议。

lines.text: How much time do you spend online every day?
About two hours. I chat with friends and stream music.
lines.cn: 大约两小时。我和朋友聊天、流播音乐。

lines.text: Do you ever worry about your privacy?
Yes. I never give out my address and I use a strong password.
lines.cn: 担心。我从不透露住址,而且用强密码。
